items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then you go across the islands... Then you went through Stockton towards Lockeford and then Clements and then turned to Ione.

ctx.x: Yeah. She also went to summer sessions at Berkeley. So she – and she’d go to the opera and symphony. All that seemed to be something that would be gone. I remember driving in the car with my father and mother – a small coupe. I was in the middle. She was crying, leaving Concord. We went on the back roads through Clayton. There was a big cattle ranch there, where my dad worked. When my mother was in Europe, he would pick me up and take me there on the weekends. We drove on those back roads – Marsh Creek Road,…
